Metadata.Goal: 把 renderer-complete EditorPlan 接入纯 canonical shell 与 host-owned revision-gated session。
Metadata.Description: 在 support 实现 command resolver、ValueHost/session actor、Scope runtime bridge、pure source lowering、真实 loader/compiler/runtime E2E 与边界文档。

TaskSpace.name: add-halfcode-schema-editor-runtime
TaskSpace.Description: 先冻结 resolver/session contracts，再实现 session 与 Scope bridge，随后以真实 source lifecycle 实现 pure lowering，最后收口 public truth 和验证。

TaskGroup.name: Command resolution contracts
TaskGroup.Description: 冻结 dispatch snapshot、safe lookup、wildcard materialization、optional arguments 和 diagnostics。

cdt:Gate.cdt:Criterion: Resolver 是无 mutation effect 的三参数 Processor。
所有 value sources 使用同一 dispatch snapshot。
不完整/非法 command 只产生 diagnostics。

Task.name: 编写 command resolver 红测试
Task.Description: 覆盖 event/value/literal、safe own-property lookup、wildcards、optional argument omission、required/type diagnostics、snapshot capture 和 no mutation。

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: 红测试证明当前 support 无 command-template runtime semantics

Task.name: 实现 command resolver 与 public result contracts
Task.Description: 实现纯 resolver、structured diagnostics、wildcard bindings、safe path traversal 和 final command validation，并从 support root 导出。

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: 全部 command kinds 可正确求值，失败不返回 partial command
Processor arity为3且不读取host/global mutable state

TaskGroup.name: ValueHost session and Scope bridge
TaskGroup.Description: 实现 host-owned revision envelopes、accepted projection Actor、subscription/pending/dispose 与 scoped capability binding。

cdt:Gate.cdt:Criterion: ValueHost 从 typed Scope runtime capability 解析，不使用 plan provenance/global registry。

Task.name: 编写 ValueHost/session/Scope 红测试
Task.Description: 覆盖 accepted/rejected/conflict、乱序/重复、pending、immutable subscription、dispose、parent inheritance/child override 和 binding ids。

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: 红测试证明当前 support 无 accepted-snapshot Actor 与 scoped host port

Task.name: 实现 revision-gated SchemaEditorSession
Task.Description: 实现 snapshot/apply envelopes、ValueHost三参数Effect port、session dispatch/pending/subscription/diagnostics/dispose 和 stale gate。

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: 仅 current-revision accepted response 推进 cloned projection
session 不本地应用 Command，dispose 后忽略 late response

Task.name: 实现 typed Scope runtime bridge
Task.Description: 把 stable host/session ids 投影到现有 Scope runtime bind/derive 机制，支持继承覆盖，不重扫 source tree。

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: 父子 Scope host capability 按现有runtime规则可见/覆盖
EditorPlan/provenance 不含 runtime capability 实现或 service locator ids

TaskGroup.name: Pure canonical shell lowering
TaskGroup.Description: 以真实 generated sources lifecycle 实现 deterministic schemaEditor.Editor shell。

cdt:Gate.cdt:Criterion: 单shell atom与plan/runtime bindings无损可解析。

Task.name: 编写 canonical shell lifecycle 红测试
Task.Description: 覆盖deterministic source bundle、single atom、plan round-trip、UI library identity、Scope bridge、no synthetic loaded bundle/host capture。

Task.name: 实现 lowerEditorPlan 与 app-runtime lifecycle
Task.Description: 生成canonical XNL sources/config bindings，复用memory resolver与loadHalfcodeAppRuntime，提供dispose-safe lifecycle。

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: 同输入产生同source，真实runtime零diagnostics且只有一个schemaEditor.Editor atom

TaskGroup.name: Public surface and documentation
TaskGroup.Description: 收口support root API、dependency boundaries、runtime docs和中立demo。

cdt:Gate.cdt:Criterion: Support root是唯一公共入口且无renderer/host mutation依赖。
文档准确区分runtime已实现与Vue/Element/Workbench未实现。

Task.name: 增加 public/dependency boundary tests
Task.Description: 验证root exports、三参数ports、contract/logic/runtime依赖和无Vue/Element/Flow/XNL writer/VFS/database泄漏。

Task.name: 更新 Schema Editor runtime 文档
Task.Description: 记录resolver/session/Scope/lowering API、时序/失败语义、三档集成和当前未实现renderer边界。

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: 文档示例与真实support root API/E2E一致且不声称UI已实现

TaskGroup.name: Verification
TaskGroup.Description: 独立验证resolver/session/lowering/Scope、三包回归、DEPA边界和Codument状态。

cdt:Gate.cdt:Criterion: 真实canonical lifecycle与revision concurrency语义通过。

Task.name: 运行 runtime 验证矩阵并记录报告
Task.Description: 运行focused/full tests、typecheck、strict validate、dependency/stale/ownership scans、diff check并写reports/verification.md。

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: 报告逐项映射五个behavior并记录给Vue renderer的runtime输出
